title: Captions at a museum screening
titleZh: 博物館放映場的字幕安排

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: My mother needs captions. Can we bring her to the museum's film on Friday, or should we wait for the repeat showing next week?
turns.zh: 我媽媽需要字幕。我們可以帶她去看博物館星期五的電影，還是該等下週重映？

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: Friday's early show has captions on the main screen. The late show offers captions only on a device you borrow. Those devices are all reserved.
turns.zh: 星期五的早場會在大銀幕上顯示字幕。晚場只能用借來的裝置看字幕，但那些裝置都已經被預約了。

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: We can make the early show. The seats at the front are sold out, though, and she can't read small text at a distance.
turns.zh: 我們趕得上早場。不過前排座位賣光了，而她離遠了就看不清小字。

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: Try the middle section. We checked the captions from there yesterday. The side seats are closer, but the speaker stands block the bottom of the screen.
turns.zh: 可以試試中間區。我們昨天從那裡確認過字幕看得清楚。側邊座位雖然比較近，但喇叭支架會擋住銀幕下方。

passageZh:
博物館訪客：我媽媽需要字幕。我們可以帶她去看博物館星期五的電影，還是該等下週重映？
博物館售票員：星期五的早場會在大銀幕上顯示字幕。晚場只能用借來的裝置看字幕，但那些裝置都已經被預約了。
博物館訪客：我們趕得上早場。不過前排座位賣光了，而她離遠了就看不清小字。
博物館售票員：可以試試中間區。我們昨天從那裡確認過字幕看得清楚。側邊座位雖然比較近，但喇叭支架會擋住銀幕下方。
audioScript:
My mother needs captions. Can we bring her to the museum's film on Friday, or should we wait for the repeat showing next week?
Friday's early show has captions on the main screen. The late show offers captions only on a device you borrow. Those devices are all reserved.
We can make the early show. The seats at the front are sold out, though, and she can't read small text at a distance.
Try the middle section. We checked the captions from there yesterday. The side seats are closer, but the speaker stands block the bottom of the screen.
